title: Naturality of normalized CE row cycles
statement: Let f:Y→X be a scheme map, K,L bounded-below complexes and D,Dprime termwise hypercohomology presentations [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. Let phi be a rowwise inverse-image chain map and u a sheaf-total map satisfying the diagonal-summand compatibility equation. Set b=totalSectionsIso.hom followed by ceSectionsLift f u and the inverse target comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison]. For any object A, p natural and q integer, filtered representatives x,y in degree q+p related by b and graded cycle maps z,zprime projecting to x,y satisfy z followed by the inverse rowCyclesIso [def-weil-pbc-ce-canonical-row-comparison] and cyclesMap(ceRowSectionsMap f (phi.f q)) equals zprime followed by the inverse target rowCyclesIso. This is an equality on cycles, before homology; no coefficient map or augmentation compatibility is assumed.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homological Algebra
source.place: Tags 015J, 015K, 0130 and 012K; normalized CE pages and diagonal row representatives

proof.text: Construct the total projection onto the (p,q) summand followed by the extension-by-zero comparison. The coproduct equations give identity on the row inclusion and zero on every summand of second index different from q. The finite-image-supremum factorization lemma shows the projection kills step q+1. Evaluation preserves cokernels, so the projection descends to the degreewise graded quotient. The canonical rowCycleClass_arrow and rowCycleStep_arrow equations then show that the inverse rowCyclesIso followed by iCycles recovers this projection on every filtered cycle representative.

For each nonnegative diagonal, use totalSectionsIso_formula, naturality of ceSectionsUnit, the given diagonal equation hu, and cancellation of the target totalSectionsIso to prove that b carries the row inclusion through the degreewise ceRowSectionsMap. Test b followed by the target row projection on all total coprojections. The q summand gives the row map; every other second index gives zero. Negative resolution summands are zero by extension by zero. Joint epimorphy of the total inclusions proves the projection naturality equation.

Cancel the target monic iCycles. Its naturality moves cyclesMap to the degreewise row map. Substitute the representative projection formula on the source and target, use projection naturality, and postcompose the supplied equality between x and y with the target projection. This yields the claimed equality without passing to homology.

theorem etaleCE_row_cycles_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
    (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
    (D : EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
    (D' : EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology Y L)
    (φ : (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D.I ⟶ D'.I)
    (u : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D.sheafTotal ⟶ D'.sheafTotal)
    (hu : ∀ (m : ℕ) (q n : ℤ) (h : (m : ℤ) + q = n),
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).map
            ((HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
              (((𝟭 (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (D.I.X q))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := m) (i' := (m : ℤ)) rfl).inv ≫
                (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor
                  (𝟭 (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))).obj
                    D.I).flip).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) q n h) ≫ u.f n =
          (φ.f q).f m ≫
            (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
              (((𝟭 (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (D'.I.X q))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := m) (i' := (m : ℤ)) rfl).inv ≫
                (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor
                  (𝟭 (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))).obj
                    D'.I).flip).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) q n h) :
      let b := D.totalSectionsIso.hom ≫ ceSectionsLift f u ≫ D'.totalSectionsIso.inv
      ∀ (A : AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}) (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ)
        (x : A ⟶ (D.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ).X
          (q + (p : ℤ)))
        (y : A ⟶ (D'.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ).X
          (q + (p : ℤ)))
        (z : A ⟶ (D.L.complexCycles q (q + (p : ℤ)) 1 : AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
        (z' : A ⟶ (D'.L.complexCycles q (q + (p : ℤ)) 1 : AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        x ≫ (D.L.step q).arrow.f (q + (p : ℤ)) ≫ b.f (q + (p : ℤ)) =
          y ≫ (D'.L.step q).arrow.f (q + (p : ℤ)) →
        z ≫ (D.L.complexCycles q (q + (p : ℤ)) 1).arrow =
          x ≫ (D.L.complexQuotientπ q (q + 1) (by omega)).f (q + (p : ℤ)) →
        z' ≫ (D'.L.complexCycles q (q + (p : ℤ)) 1).arrow =
          y ≫ (D'.L.complexQuotientπ q (q + 1) (by omega)).f (q + (p : ℤ)) →
        z ≫ (D.rowCyclesIso p q).inv ≫ HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap
            (ceRowSectionsMap f (φ.f q)) p =
          z' ≫ (D'.rowCyclesIso p q).inv
